verdict.rationale: Dover documents a REST API and publishes a machine-readable spec at app.dover.com/docs/api.json for generating clients or feeding AI tools. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference, try-it console, or runnable examples. A raw spec file is a developer building block, not the interactive explorer this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
